title: When the Veil Turns
author: Ines Delacroix
blurb: Freya Underhill, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
